Your Buyer Portal Guide

502 MacArthur Ave NE, Vienna — what each part of the portal shows you, and how to use it.

1

Your First Look

502 MacArthur Ave NE, Vienna

This is the front door to everything you need to know about the home: photography, values, documents and how to write an offer, all in one place.

Tap Pricing Report at top left for the printable Buyer Pricing Report, with the authenticated values and the sales behind them. Scan the QR code at top right to put this portal on your phone.

The offered price sits under the address, with a link to the home’s own website.

2

The Home at a Glance

Six bedrooms, remodeled 2021–22, no HOA

The strip gives you the numbers that matter: 6 bedrooms, 4.5 baths, 4,754 finished square feet on three levels, a 0.31-acre lot, built in 2007, a two-car garage and no HOA.

Contract deadlines and questions go straight to the co-listing agents named above the strip.

The four stories below it tell you what sets this home apart: a top-to-bottom remodel, the owner’s suite, a finished lower level with two more bedrooms, and a level, private lot a short walk from Church Street.

3

Authenticated Values™

How the price was set, and the sales behind it

These values come from the CST Pricing Team, not an online estimate. Every number is built from qualified comparable sales of similar size, age, location and time.

The table shows each sale used: when it was built, its size, lot, assessment and what it sold for. The shaded rows average them by age and size, and by price range.

Customary Value is what a home of this standard commands. Premium Value is what it commands when upgrades, finishes and presentation exceed the standard. Use both to decide where your offer belongs.

Historically, CST listings sell between Customary and Premium Values. Sometimes more.

4

Features, Updates and What the Owners Love

Every improvement, with the year it was done

Top Features covers the floor plan, the gourmet kitchen with its large island, the owner’s suite, the finished lower level and the walk to the Town of Vienna and the W&OD Trail.

Updates & Improvements dates every major item, from the 2021–22 remodel to the 2023 water heater, so you know exactly what is new.

What the Owners Love is in their own words: the block party, the private backyard, and the walk to Wolftrap Elementary, Glyndon Park and Church Street events.

5

The Neighborhood

Ayr Hill Heights, Vienna

The red pin is the home. Every numbered stop is within about a mile, with walk or drive times listed under the map.

Wolftrap Elementary, Glyndon Park and Caboose Brewing on the W&OD Trail are an easy walk. Old town Vienna is three minutes by car.

The arrows along the edges point to places just past the map: Wolf Trap Park, Tysons Corner, Reagan National, Dulles and the Vienna Metro.

6

Move Up Calculator

What your current home puts toward this one

Enter what you expect to sell your current home for and what you still owe. The calculator subtracts typical selling costs and shows your walk out the door proceeds.

Those proceeds become your down payment, after lender, title and closing costs. Add any extra cash in Additional down payment.

Switch between Customary and Premium to see how much the monthly payment changes. Payments use a 2-1 buydown: a lower rate in Years 1 and 2, then the full rate. Tap Math to see every number behind it.
